source_read: the seven Ten Kites menu pages (menus.tenkites.com/hwc/hwialacarte?mguid=..., hwialacarte, hwisaturday, hwisundaynew, hwibarmenu, hwikids, hwidrinks), downloaded fresh 2026-10-08, one request each; robots.txt of menus.tenkites.com disallows only /fonts/, /views/ and *.less
notes: Independent Playwright DOM read of all 478 pop-ups (the script's 74+75+74+66+26+23+140) matched all 220 published items on calories, protein, carbs, sugars, fat, saturates, salt, contains, may contain, gluten cereals, tree-nut types and the vegetarian tag (two items by hand: 'classice Dijon mustard dressing' and 'Pineapple & Pink Grapefuit Cooler' are spelling slips on the page). A re-run of heartwood_inns.py on the fresh pages reproduces data/source exactly. The 25 existing holdbacks were spot-checked against the printed figures (all real self-contradictions). Held back (HOLD_NAMES): Bramley apple crumble, marked Vegan + soya only with no gluten on all four menus and no gluten-free wording. Marked ok: five ice-cream flavours (the page itself says Suitable for Vegan), Harvey's Bristol Cream (a sherry), three dishes whose own kcal differ 23-30% from their macros (below the script's 35% hold rule: founder may want to tighten it) and the chateaubriand for two (13.4 g salt, for two). Schema note: a cereal named only under 'May contain' is dropped when gluten is already under 'Contains'.
